notablePrerequisites:
Sinstriker's Will attached to Warchanter Skald.
Warchanter Skald does not have summoning sickness.
There is an attacking or blocking creature on the battlefield.
description:
Activate Warchanter Skald using the Sinstriker's Will ability by tapping it, targeting any attacking or blocking creature.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creating a 2/1 Dwarf Berserker token.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
